subject: general
question: In which year was the 'Naye Bharat Ke Sapne' campaign launched by Meta and the Ministry of Women?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The "**Naye Bharat Ke Sapne" campaign, also known as the Amrit Generation Movement, was launched by Meta and the Ministry of Women and Child Development on June 8, 2023. **
 
• The campaign's **goals are to:**
 
 
• Empower and engage young people in India
 
• Encourage young people to express their dreams and aspirations
 
• Provide support to help young people achieve their dreams
 
 
 
• The **campaign invites young people to create Reels on Instagram and Facebook to showcase their creativity and share their aspirations.**
 
• The campaign will select **50 entries and invite them to New Delhi to interact with industry leaders and policymakers.**
 
• The selected young people will also get to visit the Meta office in Gurugram to learn from industry leaders and creators.
 
• The **Ministry of Women and Child Development is responsible for the overall development of women and children in India. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Organization:

 
• The **Ministry of Women and Child Development is headed by Hon'ble Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi.**
 
• Minister of State Sushri Debasree Chaudhuri
 
• S**hri Rabindra Panwar is the Secretary of the Ministry of Women and Child Development**

The Ministry has 6 autonomous organizations:

 
• National Institute of Public Cooperation and Child Development (NIPCCD)
 
• National Commission for women (NCW)
 
• National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR)
 
• Central Adoption Resource Agency (CARA)
 
• Central Social Welfare Board (CSWB)
 
• Rashtriya Mahila Kosh (RMK)
